observations.behavior: Adds a Django management command resync_schemas_non_billable that accepts schema IDs, a file, and options for reset, sleep, and live-run, and triggers non-billable warehouse resync workflows.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides an operator-facing CLI entry point to trigger warehouse resynces without billing, including batch and dry-run support.

observations.behavior: Adds unit tests for the new command, including dry-run, live-run, reset, limit, and failure handling, and option validation.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression and behavior checks for the new command and its options.
